CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  May 4, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Chen, Dorado, Grijalva, Juarez, Mojarro, Gardea, Olson

  Absent:  Ho

  Staff Present: Maia McCurley, Planning Manager; Megan Wu, Senior Planner; Jessica
  Vargas, Associate Planner; Daphne Madrigal, Planning Technician;
  Karabeth Garcia, Executive Assistant; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – APRIL 6, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the April 6, 2026, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the April 6, 2026, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  MINUTES – DECEMBER 7, 2020
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the December 7, 2020, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the December 7, 2020, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  MINUTES – NOVEMBER 16, 2020
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the November 16, 2020, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the November 16, 2020, Regular
  Meeting of the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  1
  5/4/2026
   AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  MINUTES – NOVEMBER 2, 2020
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the November 2, 2020, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the November 2, 2020, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Items 1, 2, 3, and 4.
  •  Moved by Vice President Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner
  Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado,  Grijalva,  Juarez,  Gardea,  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Mojarro
  Absent:  Ho

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 5:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-26-01
  • 1212 South Atlantic Boulevard, Unit 202
  • Applicant: Hope Le Bui
  • Request: This is an application for a Conditional Use Permit to
  establish a 1,167-square-foot vocational training school, known
  as “SC Healthcare College,” within an existing one-story 10,550-
  square-foot building at 1212 South Atlantic Boulevard, Unit 202
  within the CMU (Commercial Mixed-Use) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 26-04, approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-26-01 to establish a vocational
  training school specializing in cardiovascular sonography within
  an existing 1,167-square-foot commercial tenant space located at
  1212 South Atlantic Boulevard, Unit 202 within the CMU
  (Commercial Mixed-Use) zone, and finding Conditional Use
  Permit CUP-26-01 to be exempt from review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301,
  Class 1 of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations, which
  exempts from CEQA review projects within existing facilities.
  • Planning Technician Daphne Madrigal provided the Staff
  presentation.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  2
  5/4/2026
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Item 5.
  •  Moved by Vice President Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner
  Dorado.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado, Grijalva, Juarez, Mojarro, Gardea, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Ho

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-26-03
  • 1645 West Valley Boulevard, Unit A
  • Applicant: Xiaoling Wang and Kaizen Chen
  • Request: This is an application for a Conditional Use Permit to
  establish an 8,746-square-foot pool and billiards hall, known as
  “Q-zone Billiards Hall,” within an existing one-story 15,600-
  square-foot building at 1645 West Valley Boulevard, Unit A, within
  the CMU (Commercial Mixed-Use) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 26-03, approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-26-03 to establish a pool and
  billiards hall within an existing 8,763-square-foot commercial
  tenant space located at 1645 West Valley Boulevard, Unit A,
  within the CMU (Commercial Mixed-Use) zone, and finding
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-26-03 to be exempt from review
  under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant
  to Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14 of the California Code of
  Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects within
  existing facilities.
  • Planning Technician Daphne Madrigal provided the Staff
  presentation.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Item 6.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Dorado, Seconded by Commissioner Chen.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado, Grijalva, Juarez, Mojarro, Gardea, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Ho

AGENDA
ITEM 7:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-24-02 & LOT MERGER
  LOTM-24-01
  • 234 South Marguerita Avenue & 237 South Curtis Avenue
  • Applicant: Jack Li, 021 Studio

  3
  5/4/2026
   •  Request: This is an application for a Planned Development
  Permit PD-24-02 and Lot Merger LOTM-24-01 to demolish six (6)
  existing residential units, merge two (2) existing parcels into one
  (1) parcel under a single ownership, and construct a new 2-story
  development with 20 residential rental units located within the RH
  (Residential High Density) zone.
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 26-06, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-24-02 and Lot Merger LOTM-
  24-01, to allow for the demolition of six (6) existing residences and
  the construction of a new 2-story development with 20 residential
  rental units, located at 234 South Marguerita Avenue and 237
  South Curtis Avenue within the RH (Residential High Density)
  zone, and finding Planned Development Permit PD-24-02 and Lot
  Merger LOTM-24-01 meet all of the criteria to be eligible for the
  CEQA exemption under Public Resources Code Section
  21080.66 and is not subject to further CEQA review.
  •  Associate Planner Jessica Vargas provided the Staff
  presentation.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Dylan Littlefield
  2.) Cody Corbett
  3.) Sophia Salgado

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Item 7 with a revision to the Resolution, indicating
  that the applicant represented that the existing units will be made
  available for interested entities for relocation, and an added condition
  of approval to prohibit the use of artificial turf on the site.
  •  Moved by Vice President Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner
  Dorado.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado, Grijalva, Juarez, Mojarro, Gardea, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Ho

G.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Wendy Kao voiced concerns regarding previously approved Agenda Item No. 6,
  stating that she was not able to attend the public hearing and that she would like
  to know the process for appeals.
  •  Constituent spoke regarding Agenda Item No. 7, urging the Commission to ensure
  the bungalow units would be preserved and relocated, and to consider all existing
  tenants of buildings proposed for demolition to accommodate new housing
  projects.
  •  Ben spoke on Agenda Item No. 6, voicing concerns for the surrounding
  neighborhood from the proposed billiards hall and also inquired about the appeals
  process.

  4
  5/4/2026
 H.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  •  There were no comments from the Planning Commission.

I.  COMMENTS FROM STAFF:

  •  Planning Manager Maia McCurley provided an update on the upcoming Planning
  Commission meetings. A community meeting presentation was provided on the
  Objective Design Standards and Design Guidelines project on Thursday, April 23rd,
  and the project will be brought to the Planning Commission at the Monday, May 18th
  meeting. The Commission will be taking a formal action on the Zoning Text
  Amendments related to the updates. The Design Guidelines will be presented to the
  Planning Commission, which the City Council will take formal action on. Additionally,
  another Planning Commission meeting is scheduled for June 1st.

J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:48 P.M. to Monday,
  May 18, 2026, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Chris Olson
  President

ATTEST:

_______________________

Executive Assistant
